answer: LIST r, t, l, h, c FROM ArtifactsCore [has ArtifactsCoreARTregID r] [has ArtifactsCoreTitle t] is of RiskAssessment has RiskAssessmentLevel l AND ALSO is of ArtifactRating [has ArtifactRatingHistSign h] has ArtifactRatingCulturalScore c WHERE (l = 'High' OR l = 'Medium') AND h > 8 AND c > 20
note: Straightforward. 'risk level' is RiskAssessmentLevel (High/Medium/Low), which matches the question's literals; RiskAssessmentDetailLevel has a different domain. Historical significance and cultural score both come from ArtifactRating, which has only 10 rows, so the answer is a single artifact.

answer: LIST r, t, erf FROM ArtifactsCore [has ArtifactsCoreARTregID r] has ArtifactsCoreTitle t AND ALSO is of SensitivityData [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentLight sl] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentTemperature stp] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentHumidity sh] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentPollutants sp] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentVibration sv] AND ALSO (if(sl = 'High', 10, if(sl = 'Medium', 5, if(sl = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(stp = 'High', 10, if(stp = 'Medium', 5, if(stp = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(sh = 'High', 10, if(sh = 'Medium', 5, if(sh = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(sp = 'High', 10, if(sp = 'Medium', 5, if(sp = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(sv = 'High', 10, if(sv = 'Medium', 5, if(sv = 'Low', 1, 0)))) / 5 AS erf WHERE erf > 4 ORDERED WITH erf DESCENDING
note: ERF = average of the five environment_* sensitivity ratings (light, temperature, humidity, pollutants, vibration) with Low=1, Medium=5, High=10 and a missing rating scored 0 -- the nested if() falls through on NULL, which reproduces a CASE ... ELSE 0. That gives 5.4, 5.2 and exactly 4.0, so the 'exceeds 4' threshold cleanly drops the third, which is good evidence the mapping is the intended one. COULD NOT EXPRESS: the 'JSON summary of all its High sensitivity ratings'. ConQuer has no string concatenation operator and no JSON functions (the function list is starts_with/ends_with/contains/like/instr/substr/length/upper/lower/abs/round/date fns/if/div), so that column is simply absent. Also note SensitivityData has only 3 rows in this database, so at most 3 artifacts can ever have an ERF.

answer: LIST r, t, d, cpi, if(cpi > 7, 'High Priority', if(cpi >= 4, 'Medium Priority', 'Low Priority')) FROM ArtifactsCore [has ArtifactsCoreARTregID r] [has ArtifactsCoreTitle t] [has ArtifactsCoreConserveStatus st] has ArtifactsCoreDynasty d AND ALSO is of ArtifactRating [has ArtifactRatingHistSign h] [has ArtifactRatingResearchScore rs] has ArtifactRatingCulturalScore c AND ALSO ((h + rs + c) * (10 - if(st = 'Excellent', 1, if(st = 'Good', 3, if(st = 'Fair', 5, if(st = 'Poor', 7, 10)))))) / 30 AS cpi WHERE d = 'Ming' OR d = 'Qing' ORDERED WITH cpi DESCENDING
note: CPI and the priority bands as defined; ties at exactly 4 resolved as 'Medium Priority' (High > 7, else Medium if >= 4, else Low). Only ArtifactRating rows can have a CPI and there are 10 of them, so only 5 Ming/Qing artifacts appear. One Qing artifact (ART69978) is dropped because it has no conservation status; a gold that used CASE ... END with no ELSE would keep it with a NULL CPI.

answer: LIST d, cpi, ba, bs FROM ArtifactsCore [has ArtifactsCoreConserveStatus st] has ArtifactsCoreDynasty d AND ALSO is of ArtifactRating [has ArtifactRatingHistSign h] [has ArtifactRatingResearchScore rs] has ArtifactRatingCulturalScore c AND ALSO ((h + rs + c) * (10 - if(st = 'Excellent', 1, if(st = 'Good', 3, if(st = 'Fair', 5, if(st = 'Poor', 7, 10)))))) / 30 AS cpi AND ALSO is of ConditionAssessment has Showcase is of EnvironmentalReadingsCore is of ConservationAndMaintenance [has ConservationAndMaintenanceBudgetAlloc ba] has ConservationAndMaintenanceBudgetStat bs
note: CPI from ArtifactRating (hist_sign + research_score + cultural_score) x (10 - status weight) / 30. Two ambiguities. (a) ArtifactRating has only 10 rows in this database, so only 9 rows survive the join even though all 995 artifacts have a dynasty (every dynasty value is non-null, so 'known dynasty' is not a real filter). (b) There is NO fact type linking an artifact to ConservationAndMaintenance: its only entity role is to EnvironmentalReadingsCore, so I reached the budget through ArtifactsCore -> ConditionAssessment -> Showcase -> EnvironmentalReadingsCore -> ConservationAndMaintenance. The alternative chain via ConditionAssessment -> LightAndRadiationReading -> EnvironmentalReadingsCore is equally defensible and gives a different row set. I read 'specific budget allocation' as BudgetAlloc (Adequate/Insufficient/Review Required) and 'generalized budget status' as BudgetStat (Available/Limited/Depleted). I required a conserve status, so an artifact with a null status is dropped rather than shown with a null CPI.

answer: LIST r, t, tc, rh, hc, if(mdr > 5 AND hc >= 2, 'Yes', 'No') FROM ArtifactsCore [has ArtifactsCoreARTregID r] [OPTIONALLY has ArtifactsCoreAgeYears ag] has ArtifactsCoreTitle t AND ALSO OPTIONALLY is of SensitivityData [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentLight sl] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentTemperature stp] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentHumidity sh] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentPollutants sp] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentVibration sv] AND ALSO OPTIONALLY is of ConditionAssessment OPTIONALLY has Showcase OPTIONALLY is of EnvironmentalReadingsCore [OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreTEMPc tc] OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreRH rh AND ALSO (if(sl = 'High', 10, if(sl = 'Medium', 5, if(sl = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(stp = 'High', 10, if(stp = 'Medium', 5, if(stp = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(sh = 'High', 10, if(sh = 'Medium', 5, if(sh = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(sp = 'High', 10, if(sp = 'Medium', 5, if(sp = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(sv = 'High', 10, if(sv = 'Medium', 5, if(sv = 'Low', 1, 0)))) / 5 AS erf AND ALSO (if(sl = 'High', 1, 0) + if(stp = 'High', 1, 0) + if(sh = 'High', 1, 0) + if(sp = 'High', 1, 0) + if(sv = 'High', 1, 0)) AS hc AND ALSO (ag * erf * (rh - 50) * (rh - 50) * tc) / 100000 AS mdr ORDERED WITH r ASCENDING
note: MDR = (age * ERF * (RH-50)^2 * temp) / 100000, with no exponent operator in ConQuer so (rh-50) is multiplied out. 'Current temperature and humidity in its display case' read as EnvironmentalReadingsCore reached via ConditionAssessment -> Showcase. 'How many high sensitivities' counted over the five environment_* ratings, matching the definition's 'environmental sensitivities'. Everything is OPTIONALLY so all artifacts appear (931 rows -- artifacts with several condition assessments repeat, which the question's 'include all artifacts' does not say how to collapse). Only one artifact scores 'Yes'.

answer: LIST cid FROM DISTINCT Showcase [has ShowcaseCaseID cid] is of EnvironmentalReadingsCore [has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreTempVar24 tv] has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreRHvar hv WHERE tv > 1 OR hv > 3 ORDERED WITH cid ASCENDING
note: Instability = TempVar24 > 1 OR RHvar > 3, read off EnvironmentalReadingsCore and projected to the showcase it monitors. DISTINCT on the head plus ordering by case id. 504 showcases.

answer: LIST cid FROM DISTINCT Showcase [has ShowcaseCaseID cid] [OPTIONALLY has ShowcasePhysicalStateLeakRatePerDay lr] [OPTIONALLY has ShowcasePhysicalStateSealState ss] [OPTIONALLY has ShowcaseMaintenanceMaintStatus ms] [OPTIONALLY has ShowcaseMaintenanceFilterStatus fs] [OPTIONALLY has ShowcaseMaintenanceSilicaStatus si] OPTIONALLY is of EnvironmentalReadingsCore [OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreTempVar24 tv] OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreRHvar hv  AND ALSO (10 - ((tv + (hv / 5) + lr) / 3)) AS sesr  AND ALSO (if(ss = 'Poor', 1, 0) + if(ms = 'Overdue', 1, 0) + if(fs = 'Replace Now', 1, 0) + if(si = 'Replace Now', 1, 0)) AS mi WHERE sesr < 5 OR mi >= 3 ORDERED WITH cid ASCENDING
note: SESR = 10 - ((TempVar24 + RHvar/5 + LeakRatePerDay)/3). Worth flagging: SESR never falls below about 8.9 in this data, so the SESR < 5 disjunct selects nothing and all 67 results come from the three-or-more-maintenance-issues test. The four maintenance literals ('Poor', 'Overdue', 'Replace Now', 'Replace Now') all exist verbatim in the data. Showcase attributes are OPTIONALLY so a showcase with no environmental reading can still qualify on maintenance alone.

answer: LIST r, tetl FROM ArtifactsCore [has ArtifactsCoreARTregID r] [OPTIONALLY has ArtifactsCoreAgeYears ag] is of RiskAssessment has RiskAssessmentLevel: 'Medium' AND ALSO is of SensitivityData [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentLight sl] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentTemperature stp] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentHumidity sh] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentPollutants sp] [OPTIONALLY has SensitivityDataEnvironmentVibration sv] AND ALSO is of ConditionAssessment has LightAndRadiationReading [OPTIONALLY has LightAndRadiationReadingLux lux] [OPTIONALLY has LightAndRadiationReadingVisLxh vis] has EnvironmentalReadingsCore [OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreTEMPc tc] OPTIONALLY has EnvironmentalReadingsCoreRH rh AND ALSO (if(sl = 'High', 10, if(sl = 'Medium', 5, if(sl = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(stp = 'High', 10, if(stp = 'Medium', 5, if(stp = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(sh = 'High', 10, if(sh = 'Medium', 5, if(sh = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(sp = 'High', 10, if(sp = 'Medium', 5, if(sp = 'Low', 1, 0))) + if(sv = 'High', 10, if(sv = 'Medium', 5, if(sv = 'Low', 1, 0)))) / 5 AS erf AND ALSO (lux * if(sl = 'High', 10, if(sl = 'Medium', 5, if(sl = 'Low', 1, 0))) * vis) / 1000 AS ler AND ALSO (ag * erf * (rh - 50) * (rh - 50) * tc) / 100000 AS mdr AND ALSO (erf + ler + (mdr * 2)) AS tetl ORDERED WITH tetl DESCENDING THE FIRST 10
note: TETL = ERF + LER + 2*MDR. I read 'second-highest risk level' as RiskAssessmentLevel 'Medium' (the domain is High/Medium/Low); if the intended table is RiskAssessmentDetail (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Negligible) it would be 'High' instead. Temperature/humidity for MDR come through ArtifactsCore -> ConditionAssessment -> LightAndRadiationReading -> EnvironmentalReadingsCore, the same chain that supplies the lux and lux-hour figures for LER; for the one artifact reachable both ways the showcase chain gives the same reading. Only 2 artifacts survive (ERF needs SensitivityData, which has 3 rows). The second has a NULL TETL because its lux is NULL -- I left it in, matching plain SQL arithmetic, but a gold that filtered NULLs would return one row.
